rows.case: NoTransaction, SIGKILL before compile: record kept, no resources
NoTransaction, process end: resources without a module record (impossible)
-dev, SIGKILL after the first commit, before the dependency: manifest kept
-dev, process end: dependency installed, top manifest absent (impossible)
-dev, SIGKILL inside Activate: manifest, resources and dependency kept
-dev, process end inside Activate: resources gone though compiled outside the transaction
